recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-5614. Address FHIR-42868 separately if a future run includes Resolved - change required items or a human explicitly asks for the value set standards-status correction.
issue_request: FHIR-5614 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core datatypes and requested that Narrative.status be required/fixed rather than extensible.
initial_application: Jira comments identify the issue as a profile generation flaw fixed in svn #4005. Git history contains b45e2949b0b8a74789f39f7f18b502738dc69351, "#5614: fix narrative status binding strength", matching that svn revision.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively maps narrative and xhtml to the narrative datatype page. The authoritative source/datatypes/narrative.xml spreadsheet binds Narrative.status to NarrativeStatus and defines NarrativeStatus as a #narrative-status code list. The current rendered CI StructureDefinition reports Narrative.status binding_strength=required. A later related FHIR-core issue, FHIR-42868, concerns making the narrative-status value set normative and remains Resolved - change required, so it was treated only as context.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scoped source and rendered CI profile already satisfy the required binding request.

related_jiras.note: Same Narrative.status value set family, but it concerns standards status rather than binding strength and is only Resolved - change required.
